newsitem.title: USA: Alza files application for testosterone patch.
newsitem.headline: Alza files application for testosterone patch.

text.p: Alza Corp said Thursday it filed a new drug application this month and is preparing clinical trials of its first product incorporating DUROS human implant technology, which is in development for the treatment of prostate cancer.
Prostate cancer is the most common malignancy in men, with the number of new cases in the United States increasing by more than 25 percent a year.
The company also said that, in December, it submitted a new drug application for a non-scrotal transdermal testosterone patch that can be worn on the arm or torso.
The product will be marketed by Alza in the United States upon receipt of marketing clearance. The Ferring Group has marketing rights in certain European countries.
